title: aralia cordata var. sachalinensis
intro: Aralia cordata var. sachalinensis, commonly known as the Japanese spikenard or Sichuan aralia, is a plant species that belongs to the Araliaceae family. This plant is traditionally used in herbal medicine to treat various health conditions, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Aralia cordata var. sachalinensis include its ability to reduce fever, relieve pain, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, phenolic acids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
